explicitOptIn.image2Api: Use --image-source image2 explicitly; OPENAI_API_KEY alone must not change the default image route.
explicitOptIn.codexBuiltinImages: Use --image-source codex-builtin --codex-image-assets-dir <dir> for Codex/Cos X app image_gen assets; this is the normal final-quality cover handoff and does not require OPENAI_API_KEY.
explicitOptIn.sayFallback: Use --allow-say-fallback explicitly; macOS say is degraded smoke evidence only.
explicitOptIn.degradedRenderer: Use --allow-degraded-renderer explicitly; ffmpeg fallback is not final-quality by default.
explicitOptIn.speedProfile: Use --speed-profile fast for faster iteration: bounded MeloTTS workers plus copy-video final audio normalization when not otherwise overridden.
explicitOptIn.ttsWorkers: Use --tts-workers 5 only for explicit benchmark/turbo runs; fast profile defaults to 3 on CPU, and non-CPU device paths stay at 1 unless benchmarked.
explicitOptIn.ttsCacheMaxBytes: Shared MeloTTS segment cache is capped at 5 GiB by default and pruned by least-recently-used audio files down to an 85% target when over limit. Override with --tts-cache-max-gb.
explicitOptIn.finalAudioMode: Use --final-audio-mode copy-video for fast iteration; default reencode-video preserves the conservative crisp-text bitrate chain.
explicitOptIn.generationMode: Full-auto is the default. Use --generation-mode semi-auto or custom only when the user explicitly asks to stop for configuration/review.
explicitOptIn.coverLocalRecompositionPreview: Set COVER_LOCAL_RECOMPOSITION_PREVIEW=1 explicitly for non-upload review previews only.
